instruction.name: TZCNT
instruction.copyright: Copyright (C) Intel Corporation. All Rights Reserved.
instruction.shortdesc: Count the Number of Trailing Zero Bits

para.string: TZCNT counts the number of trailing least significant zero bits in source operand (second operand) and returns the result in the destination operand (first operand). TZCNT is an extension of the BSF instruction. The key difference between the TZCNT and BSF instructions is that when the source operand is zero, TZCNT outputs the operand size to the destination operand, whereas BSF leaves the destination operand unmodified.
On processors that do not support TZCNT, the instruction byte encoding is executed as BSF.

ZF is set to 1 in case of zero output (least significant bit of the source is set), and to 0 otherwise, CF is set to 1 if the input was zero and cleared otherwise. OF, SF, PF, and AF flags are undefined.
